policy: Every entry is code that exists only to read or convert names Stave no longer uses, or to replay a rename on another branch. `bun run check:temporary-migrations` fails once package.json reaches removeInVersion; delete the marked blocks, the listed tests and the entry before that release. See AGENTS.md, Temporary Migrations.

migrations.description: Through 0.29.2 Fleet View opened on workspace cards and every profile saved fleetBoardLayout: cards, so a saved cards cannot tell a choice from the old default. After 0.29.2 the Tree layout is the default. Settings rehydration moves a saved cards (or a profile saved without the key) to tree once, keeps table, and writes the fleetTreeDefaultApplied marker so a later choice of Cards is kept; it runs only while the marker is absent. At expiry, delete the marked blocks; a profile that skipped these releases keeps its saved cards, and the leftover marker key is ignored.

The spacing ratchet keys declarations by their text. A PR whose base commit predates the AUI rename (#814) has `--ads-*` keys there, so the renamed declarations would read as new debt. The check compares the base keys after the same rename. At expiry every open branch is based after the rename; delete the marked block.
